title: Combine P104 decoder gauges using paid row budgets
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Combines separate gauges using an explicit binary-rank budget on every actual paid row. A full exact P104 decoder gives a weighted bound of 104 with a best single-gauge subset of 52. The pinned E8 example gives a unit-weight bound of 17 versus a best single subset of 6. Exact controls disprove relying on disjointness alone or general submodularity.

## Task and overlap

Uses #7852 at 41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212. Credits the #7869 DEN4 single-gauge deep-port argument at 06c207a9feb3994a4b987dc3010657b6e85b7956, which relates to the earlier #7855 count. The addition is the independent-gauge combination with shared row budgets and the corresponding examples and controls.

## Validation and credit

The clean-copy standard-library verifier checks 21 manifested files, 12 upstream byte/Git-blob mappings, both receipts, gauge and decoder controls, overlap and rank non-submodularity. A copied source mutation was rejected. Research and checking were AI-assisted with Codex. Thanks to DreamingOfClouds and the original P104 decoder contributors.

## Open next questions

Find usable row budgets in the remaining loose-row classes. A general decoder wall and Lean proof remain open.
